Our Commitment

Small Brand,
Big Promise

Threadiva is a grassroots sustainable fashion label born from the belief that style and responsibility can coexist beautifully. We are growing — slowly, intentionally, and with purpose.

Every stitch, every dye, every packaging choice is made with the next generation in mind. We aren't a corporation — we're a collective of people who care deeply about the world we dress in.

🧵

Zero-Waste Cutting

We repurpose fabric scraps into accessories, reducing textile waste at the source.

📦

Plastic-Free Packaging

All orders ship in recycled paper and biodegradable materials — no plastics, ever.

🌊

Natural Dyes Only

Plant-based and mineral dyes, keeping toxic chemicals far from waterways and skin.

Looking Forward

Our 2030 Commitment

As a small brand, we believe our actions speak louder than any campaign. Here is exactly what we are building toward — and how we're different.

Our Roadmap

The Journey to 2030

Brand Foundation

Threadiva launched with a small Boho collection, partnering with two local artisan groups and sourcing 100% natural fabrics from day one.

2024
2025

Zero Plastic Packaging

Full transition to 100% plastic-free packaging. All orders now ship in recycled kraft paper with biodegradable twine — no exceptions.

Expand Artisan Network

Partner with 10+ artisan collectives across Rajasthan, Gujarat and West Bengal. Provide fair-trade certified income to 50+ weavers and embroiderers.

2026
2027

Plant-Based Dye Lab

Establish our own natural dye workshop, transitioning 80% of production to in-house plant-based and mineral dyes, ensuring full supply chain transparency.

Take-Back Programme

Launch a garment take-back initiative — customers return worn Threadiva pieces and receive credits. Fabrics are repurposed or composted, never landfilled.

2028
2030

Carbon Neutral Operations

Full carbon neutrality across production, logistics, and packaging. Plant 10,000 trees with reforestation NGOs. Empower 200+ artisan livelihoods across India.

What Makes Us Different

We're Not Like Other Brands

And that's exactly the point. Here's why women choose Threadiva.

01

Genuinely Affordable Sustainability

Our Boho tops start at ₹799 and bracelets at ₹599 — because sustainable fashion should be for everyone. We don't believe you have to choose between your wallet and your values.

02

Truly Handmade, Not Just Labelled

Every Threadiva piece is genuinely handcrafted by skilled artisans. We visit our makers. We know their names. We share their stories. This isn't a marketing claim — it's our heartbeat.

03

No Greenwashing, Ever

We are a small brand and we are honest about it. We don't claim perfection. We share our challenges alongside our wins. If something isn't sustainable yet, we say so — and we show you our plan.

04

Slow Fashion That Lasts

We produce in small, intentional batches. No overproduction, no clearance sales to offload excess. Each piece is made to be worn for years — the craftsmanship and timeless Boho aesthetic support a longer life.

05

Direct Supply Chain

We source fabrics directly from organic cotton farmers and khadi weavers, cutting out middlemen. This keeps costs fair for customers while ensuring artisans receive equitable pay.

06

Community First, Growth Second

We are deliberately growing slowly — because rushed growth leads to compromised values. Our community of customers, artisans, and planet advocates comes before revenue targets, always.

Our Story

Born from a Love for
Earth & Expression

Threadiva is more than a brand. It's a movement — small, sincere, and unstoppable.

Why Threadiva Exists

Threadiva was born from a simple frustration: why does sustainable fashion have to be expensive, inaccessible, or boring? We believed it didn't — and set out to prove it.

Starting as a very small operation with a handful of artisan partners and a deep love for Boho aesthetics, Threadiva has grown organically — through word of mouth, genuine connections, and a community of women who share our values.

We are not trying to become the next big brand. We are trying to become the most honest, most caring, and most beautifully conscious small brand in India. That's our north star.

🌱
Our Mission
To make sustainable, handcrafted Boho fashion genuinely affordable and accessible for every Indian woman, while nurturing artisan communities and the planet.
🔭
Our Vision
A fashion industry where ethical production is the norm, artisans are celebrated, and no woman has to choose between style and sustainability.
💎
Our Values
Radical transparency. Artisan equity. Environmental responsibility. Affordable beauty. Community over competition. Slow growth, deep roots.
"We started Threadiva because we wanted fashion that makes you feel beautiful without making the earth pay for it. Small scale isn't a limitation — it's our greatest strength."
— Threadiva Founder
Our Passion

What Drives Everything We Do

🧵

The Art of Handcraft

We are obsessed with the beauty of things made by human hands. Every embroidered stitch, every hand-loomed thread carries the spirit of the artisan. That is something no machine can replicate — and we will never stop celebrating it.

🌍

The Future of Fashion

The fashion industry is one of the world's biggest polluters. We are passionate about proving a different model is possible — one that is kind to people and planet, without sacrificing beauty or affordability.

👩🏽

Women Empowering Women

From the women artisans who craft our pieces to the women who wear them — Threadiva is a brand by women, for women. We create economic opportunity for female weavers while helping our customers express who they truly are.

📈

Thoughtful Expansion

We want to grow — but not at the cost of our values. Every new product and partnership will be held to the same standard: is this good for people, and good for the planet? If yes, we grow. If not, we wait.

© 2025 Threadiva. Made with purpose.

📷🐦📘
Right Now, Today

Our Real-World Impact

What we are actively doing — not just planning — to make a difference for the planet and people.

Current Actions

What Threadiva is Doing Right Now

We're a small brand — every action listed here is real, current, and ongoing. No empty pledges.

🌿

Natural Fabric Sourcing

We source 100% of our fabrics from organic cotton and khadi producers — every bolt of cloth is chemical-free and purchased directly from farmers at fair prices.

  • Direct partnerships with organic cotton farms in Gujarat
  • Khadi fabric from government-certified weavers
  • No synthetic blends, ever — including trims and linings
  • Fabric scraps repurposed into accessories and stuffing
🎨

Plant-Based Dyeing

Threadiva uses only plant-based and mineral dyes — madder root for reds, indigo for blues, turmeric for yellows. Zero toxic discharge into water systems.

  • All dye wastewater composted as garden fertiliser
  • Each dye batch documented and traceable
  • Colours vary slightly — that's the beauty of natural dye
  • No synthetic fixatives or mordants used
📦

Plastic-Free Packaging

Every Threadiva order uses zero plastic. This was a day-one commitment and it hasn't wavered once.

  • Recycled kraft paper wrapping for all garments
  • Biodegradable jute twine instead of tape
  • Seed-embedded thank-you cards — plant them!
  • Boxes made from 80% post-consumer recycled cardboard
🤝

Artisan Fair Wages

We pay above market rates to every artisan we work with, built on long-term relationships rather than one-off orders designed to squeeze margins.

  • All artisans paid 30–40% above local market rates
  • Payment within 7 days of order completion
  • Festival bonuses for regular artisan partners
  • Skills development support for younger weavers
Our Pledge to Nature

Beyond our products, we commit 2% of every sale toward environmental causes and reforestation across India.

🌳

Reforestation

2% of all sales goes toward planting native trees in depleted forest zones across central India.

💧

Water Conservation

Our dye process uses minimal water and all wastewater is treated and composted — nothing enters drains.

♻️

Zero-Waste Studio

Our production studio sends zero fabric to landfill. All offcuts become accessories, stuffing, or are composted.

🌾

Soil Health

We support organic farming practices that restore soil health and avoid pesticide runoff into ecosystems.

© 2025 Threadiva. Every stitch matters.
